title: Tom DeLonge narrative of a Majestic-style controlling group

tellings.quote: basically the Tom Delong narrative right where he's like gota is basically of the mayard group

plain: The musician turned UFO campaigner Tom DeLonge is said to tell of a secret controlling group in the United States, along the lines of Majestic, a rumoured top-secret committee said to run UFO matters behind the scenes. The analyst Matthew Pines sums up "the Tom DeLonge narrative" in passing, relaying DeLonge's version that such a group sits at the top, which would mean UFO secrets are held by a small, unseen body.
